headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when the AEW Women's World Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Thunder Rosa vs. Britt Baker battled it out in a Steel Cage match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.88 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. A violent, historic rematch ? only the third-ever steel cage match in AEW history, and the first involving women ? Rosa ended Baker's 290-day reign with a Thunder Driver Slam in front of her own adopted hometown crowd, capping a rivalry that began with an equally brutal Lights Out war exactly a year earlier.
On this day in 2024, Bryan Danielson vs. Katsuyori Shibata delivered a stone-cold classic on Collision, rated 8.59.
2022 brought us this moment: Jeff Hardy touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.70.

secondaries.text: It was 2022 when Jurassic Express & Page kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.40 ? a well-worked match.
Rewind to 2024, when Kyle O'Reilly made their long-awaited comeback after just under 2 years away, appearing on Collision.
2024 brought us this moment: it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Shawn Dean returned to the ring after just over 15 months away, appearing on Collision.
